visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and glasses wearing a pink button-down shirt stands in a brightly lit kitchen. She holds a long, pale yellow sheet of pasta dough towards the lens. Two tiny, miniature versions of herself are digitally edited to appear as if they are interacting with the bottom of the pasta sheet. (2) The woman holds a bag of flour labeled '麥典' in her right hand and a white egg in her left. The background shows a wooden shelf with kitchen jars and a pasta machine. (3) A close-up shot shows a mound of white flour on a white countertop with two yellow egg yolks in a central well. A hand enters the frame to crack a second egg. (4) The woman uses a white plastic scraper and a fork to combine the eggs into the flour, turning the dry powder into a shaggy, wet yellow dough. (5) Her hands are shown kneading a smooth, firm ball of dough on the counter. She then wraps the dough tightly in clear plastic wrap, creating a glossy sphere. (6) The dough is fed through a silver pasta machine. A tiny version of the woman sits on top of the sheet as it flattens and extends. The dough becomes increasingly thin and translucent. (7) A cutting attachment is fixed to the machine, and the sheet is processed into uniform, flat linguine strands that fall in a rhythmic curtain. (8) The woman's hands gather the pasta strands and twist them into neat circular nests, placing them on a metal baking tray lined with parchment paper. (9) She sprinkles more flour over the nests and then places one nest into a teal-colored reusable silicone storage bag, holding it up to the camera with a wide smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a friendly female voiceover in Mandarin. The voice is clear and professional, with moderate pitch and steady rhythm. (2) A subtle 'crack' sound effect accompanies the visual of the egg, followed by the soft, rhythmic scraping sound of a fork against a surface as the dough is mixed. (3) The background music remains constant as the narrator explains the dough kneading process. A soft 'thump' sound is heard during the kneading visual. (4) A mechanical 'whirr' and light metallic clicking sounds are layered in as the pasta machine is used. These sounds are clearly post-produced sound effects synced with the visual motion. (5) As the pasta is cut, a 'sh-sh-sh' swishing sound effect emphasizes the strands falling. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's voice becoming slightly more upbeat, paired with a final 'ding' sound effect as the product is bagged and displayed.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an instructional cooking tutorial and brand endorsement for '麥典' flour. It aims to demonstrate the simplicity of making fresh pasta at home using a 1:1 flour-to-egg ratio. The creator uses a fast-paced, visually engaging style with miniature digital effects to maintain viewer interest while highlighting the quality of the endorsed flour.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The brand '麥典' is prominently shown on the flour bag, mentioned multiple times in the speech and subtitles, and the flour is the central ingredient of the recipe.
